auditor: Claude (included subscription session; not a paid API call)
scope: All 58 machine-eligible items of the quality-v5 measurement cohort. Audit verdicts are NOT publication evidence and do not alter any receipt.
method: Each item read as a strict CUET paper setter: key recomputed, every option tested as a proposition, stated conditions, CUET format and student-facing presentation checked; source excerpts consulted where a claim was doubtful.

verdict_scale.publish_ready: Correct, unique, self-contained, CUET-format; no change needed (9-10/10)
verdict_scale.acceptable_weak: Correct and unique but with a weak, implausible or trivially eliminable distractor, rote phrasing or low exam value (about 8/10)
verdict_scale.defect: Should not be published as is
verdict_scale.duplicate_surplus: Correct but substantively the same idea as another eligible item; not new inventory

defect_classes_for_the_generator: Options carrying their own letter labels ('(A) Rs 400') - deterministic lint can reject this.
Synonym/antonym items with definition-phrase options - deterministic lint can reject this.
Near-duplicate ideas across blueprints of different anchors (AD = C + I four times; bank-rate chain twice) - planning must deduplicate by tested idea across the subject.
Weak, absurd distractors still pass both model gates and the >=9 score.
Authentic originals stored with flattened list text need presentation restoration before publication.
No item was generated at 'hard' difficulty.
limitations: One reviewer; model agreement, quality scores, matching official keys and this audit do not guarantee zero errors.
